## Team knowledge candidate

- [ ] The candidate contains reusable CAD/BIM instructions rather than a chat transcript.
- [ ] Client names, project names, model paths, element IDs, personal paths, and credentials are absent.
- [ ] Verification claims match the evidence described in the skill.
- [ ] The repository owner approves adding or changing every listed skill.

Automatic checks are a safety filter, not approval. Do not merge until the repository owner has reviewed the instructions and any executable files.
